40208-life-of-thomas-paine-written-purpo.title: Life Of Thomas Paine Written Purposely To Bind With His Writ
40208-life-of-thomas-paine-written-purpo.creator: Richard Carlile
40208-life-of-thomas-paine-written-purpo.description: A book by Richard Carlile. Thomas Paine was born at Thetford, in the county of Norfolk, in England, on the 29th of January, 1737. He received such education as the town could afford him, until he was thirteen years of age, when his father, who was a staymaker, took him upon the shop-board. Before his twentieth year, he set out for London to work as a journeyman, and from London to the coast of Kent.

arxiv-2003-06156.title: Gimme’ Signals: Discriminative signal encoding for multimodal activity recognition
arxiv-2003-06156.creator: Raphael Memmesheimer, Nick Theisen, Dietrich Paulus
arxiv-2003-06156.description: Abstract We present a simple, yet effective and flexible method for action recognition supporting multiple sensor modalities. Multivariate signal sequences are encoded in an image and are then classified using a recently proposed EfficientNet CNN architecture. Our focus was to find an approach that generalizes well across different sensor modalities without specific adaptions while still achieving good results.

arxiv-2011-06485.title: Fairness and Robustness in Invariant Learning: A Case Study in Toxicity Classification
arxiv-2011-06485.creator: Robert Adragna, Elliot Creager, David Madras, Richard Zemel
arxiv-2011-06485.description: Abstract Robustness is of central importance in machine learning and has given rise to the fields of domain generalization and invariant learning, which are concerned with improving performance on a test distribution distinct from but related to the training distribution.

arxiv-2209-13666.title: Predicting cell stress and strain during extrusion bioprinting
arxiv-2209-13666.creator: Sebastian J. Müller, Ben Fabry, Stephan Gekle
arxiv-2209-13666.description: Abstract Bioprinting of living cells can cause major shape deformations, which may severely affect cell survival and functionality. While the shear stresses occurring during cell flow through the printer nozzle have been quantified to some extent, the extensional stresses occurring as cells leave the nozzle into the free printing strand have been mostly ignored.

arxiv-2403-09922.title: A Refined Proximal Algorithm for Nonconvex Multiobjective Optimization in Hilbert Spaces
arxiv-2403-09922.creator: G. C. Bento ∗, J. X. Cruz Neto, J. O. Lopes, B. S. Mordukhovich, P. R. Silva Filho
arxiv-2403-09922.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by G. C. Bento ∗, J. X. Cruz Neto, J. O. Lopes, B. S. Mordukhovich, P. R. Silva Filho. This paper is devoted to general nonconvex problems of multiobjective optimization in Hilbert spaces. Based on Mordukhovich’s limiting subgradients, we define a new notion of Pareto critical points for such problems, establish necessary optimality conditions for them, and then employ these conditions to develop a refined version of the vectorial proximal point algorithm with providing its detailed convergence analysis.

arxiv-2405-01766.title: Linear equations and multiplicative polynomial equations in infinitely many variables Thanks: MBN supported in part by PSC-CUNY Research Award Program grant 66197-00 54.
arxiv-2405-01766.creator: Melvyn B. Nathanson, David A. Ross
arxiv-2405-01766.description: Abstract . This paper describes infinite sets of linear and polynomial equations in infinitely many variables with the property that the existence of a solution or even an approximate solution for every finite subset of the equations implies the existence of a solution for the infinite set of equations.

arxiv-2411-03675.title: QUILL: Quotation Generation Enhancement of Large Language Models
arxiv-2411-03675.creator: Jin Xiao, Bowei Zhang, Qianyu He, Jiaqing Liang, Feng Wei, Jinglei Chen, Zujie Liang, Deqing Yang, Yanghua Xiao
arxiv-2411-03675.description: Abstract While Large language models (LLMs) have become excellent writing assistants, they still struggle with quotation generation. This is because they either hallucinate when providing factual quotations or fail to provide quotes that exceed human expectations. To bridge the gap, we systematically study how to evaluate and improve LLMs’ performance in quotation generation tasks.

arxiv-2503-04313.title: Episodes from the history of infinitesimals
arxiv-2503-04313.creator: Mikhail G. Katz
arxiv-2503-04313.description: Abstract . Infinitesimals have seen ups and downs in their tumultuous history. In the 18th century, d’Alembert set the tone by describing infinitesimals as chimeras. Some adversaries of infinitesimals, including Moigno and Connes, picked up on the term. We highlight the work of Cauchy, Noël, Poisson and Riemann.

arxiv-2506-18911.title: Universal inverse Radon transforms: Complexity of Radon transforms and the hybrid functions.
arxiv-2506-18911.creator: I. V. Anikin
arxiv-2506-18911.description: Abstract For the reconstruction problem, the universal representation of inverse Radon transforms may imply the needed complexity of the direct Radon transforms which leads to the additional contributions. Meanwhile, in the standard theory of generalized functions, if the origin function which generates the Radon image is a pure-real function, as a rule the complexity of Radon transform becomes in question.

arxiv-2508-18496.title: Searching for the Leptophilic Gauge Boson Z l at Future e + ​ e − e^{+}e^{-} Colliders
arxiv-2508-18496.creator: S. O. Kara
arxiv-2508-18496.description: Abstract We study the discovery prospects of the leptophilic photon Z l Z_{l} , a hypothetical gauge boson beyond the Standard Model, at future electron–positron colliders. Our analysis is based on the process e + ​ e − → μ + ​ μ − e^{+}e^{-}\to\mu^{+}\mu^{-} and consistently includes realistic effects such as initial state radiation and beamstrahlung.

pmc-11487830.title: Meta-analysis accelerator: a comprehensive tool for statistical data conversion in systematic reviews with meta-analysis
pmc-11487830.creator: Abdallah Abbas, Mahmoud Tarek Hefnawy, Ahmed Negida
pmc-11487830.description: BackgroundSystematic review with meta-analysis integrates findings from multiple studies, offering robust conclusions on treatment effects and guiding evidence-based medicine. However, the process is often hampered by challenges such as inconsistent data reporting, complex calculations, and time constraints. Researchers must convert various statistical measures into a common format, which can be error-prone and labor-intensive without the right tools.

pmc-12748914.title: Hematological markers as prognostic predictors in patients undergoing colon cancer surgery
pmc-12748914.creator: Jessica Patricia Gonzales Stuva, Carlos Pérez-López, Marcelo Sebastian Ramírez Romero, Ana Bernabeu García, Pamela Vivas Angeles, Diana Escolà Ripoll, Sandra López Gordo
pmc-12748914.description: To determine if neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio (NLR), lymphocyte-to-monocyte ratio (LMR), and platelet-to-lymphocyte ratio (PLR), can predict postoperative complications (PC), 5-year survival, and 5-year disease-free survival (DFS) in stages I-III colon adenocarcinoma, analyzing outcomes generally and by tumor location (right colon vs. left colon).

pmc-13012360.title: Addition of immersive virtual reality-mediated programs with conventional physiotherapy on quality of life in knee osteoarthritis – A protocol of a randomized controlled trial
pmc-13012360.creator: Kamalakannan Rathinavel, Ajay Kumar, Rajasekar Sannasi, Prem Venkatesan
pmc-13012360.description: BACKGROUND:Knee osteoarthritis (OA) is a debilitating condition causing persistent pain that significantly impacts a patient’s physical and psychological wellbeing, ultimately reducing their quality of life. Existing research predominantly compares immersive virtual reality (IVR) with passive treatments of electrotherapy, neglecting comparisons with active exercise-based conventional physiotherapy interventions.

pmc-13267090.title: Experiences with the use of asfotase alfa in three patients with childhood-onset hypophosphatasia
pmc-13267090.creator: Francesca Pigliaru, Davide Noto, Maria Luisa Brandi
pmc-13267090.description: SummaryHypophosphatasia (HPP) is a rare inherited metabolic disorder characterized by deficient activity of serum alkaline phosphatase due to loss-of-function mutations in the ALPL gene. Diagnosis confirmation, management, and follow-up of HPP are challenging, and clinical guidance is scant due to the difficulty in gathering high-level evidence.

uslaw-usc-t18-s201.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t18-s201.description: United States Code, Title 18 (Crimes And Criminal Procedure); Part I (Crimes); Chapter 11 (Bribery, Graft, And Conflicts Of Interest). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) For the purpose of this section— (1) the term “public official” means Member of Congress, Delegate, or Resident Commissioner, either before or after such official has qualified, or an officer or employee or person acting for.
